
pcPAD
=====

This is a port of the microPAD firmware for PC. It can be used with miniBTX on a regular 
linux PC.

Since miniBTX in its current form does not have any control lines connected to the serial
port, this software can not monitor the terminal status. The user has to bring up the
terminal first and tell the software manually when the terminal is up.

This software supports loading the videotex pages from a local directory or from a 
webserver.

Have also a look at src/start.sh
